decisions.decision: The bottleneck is the absence of a residual edge, not the gate/power/mechanisms; stop adding mechanisms and change the target.
The forecaster must be benchmarked against linear/MLP/pretrained before any further controller work.

1h cross-sectional/reversal is closed (AC -0.013; residual 20.8% but rank IC -0.050 and rank-book break-even -0.042 bps, sign-unstable). Reversal must be tested at 15m; a cross-section needs a wide universe + conditional factors.
Buy independence from a new data source (15m bars and/or funding/basis), not from more bars of the same eight.
A verdict must be configuration-robust and exposure-matched before any cross-family claim.
Replace schedule-bound retraining with continuous small-footprint adaptation, with cadence-invariance as its acceptance test.
Meta-labeling is gated on P1 (it cannot rescue a negative-skill primary).
The adjusted-DSR hurdle is a surface in (Sharpe, designEffect, moments, K); the binding term for the best arms is the design effect, so the lever is an independent return series.
Ensemble size is a gated pre-registered probe (P7), not a default change; the principled default is a learned/dimension-sized es (P7b).
The 1h cross-sectional close rests on unpredictability and sign-instability, not on a small residual (residual 20.8%, rank IC -0.035, reversal sign flips across constructions -0.05 vs -0.29).
Id namespace: the plan's decisions are D1-D11 (PLAN §6); directions are identified by P#/R#/G#/C#/MC#/B#/FG#. No D# id labels a direction.

gates.if: a linear/MLP/TSFM forecaster has positive Brier skill vs the base rate
gates.then: architecture is the constraint: run P6 and P7 with the new primary
gates.else: features/labels are the constraint: skip P6/P7, put the round into P3/P4
gates.outcome: MEASURED -> ELSE branch: no forecaster beats the base rate, so features/labels are the constraint; P6/P7 closed (RUN-ANALYSIS.md §16.2).

gates.if: the 15m reversal clears break-even, adjDSR and SPA at a majority of cadences
gates.then: new candidate sleeve; re-scope P4's independence test around it
gates.else: record the rejection; shift the round's weight to P4
gates.outcome: MEASURED -> ELSE branch: the 15m reversal does not clear break-even at taker cost (0.32-0.56 bps) and fails adjDSR at every cadence; recorded as a full non-acceptance (RUN-ANALYSIS.md §16.4).

gates.if: the carry stream moves the best arm's dsrAdjusted across 0.95
gates.then: carry is a real independence purchase
gates.else: rejected as a breadth purchase, recorded with the measured correlation
gates.outcome: MEASURED -> ELSE branch: the sleeve is a breadth purchase by the DSR metric (no arm crosses 0.95) and an independence purchase by the correlation/effective-streams metric (+0.003 vs 0.29-0.52; 1.25 -> 1.54 effective streams of 9) (RUN-ANALYSIS.md §16.5).

gates.if: the TTA arm's level is approx invariant across testSize {10,15}, goldens unmoved when off
gates.then: the cadence step is retired as a free parameter
gates.else: record that TTA does not remove the configuration dependence
gates.outcome: OPEN - NOT MEASURED: P5 deferred, so no cadence-invariance claim exists either way (RUN-ANALYSIS.md §16.6).

gates.if: some es improves Brier skill vs the base rate beyond the seed spread
gates.then: record the es-skill curve and re-open the architecture question (couples to G-A)
gates.else: capacity is not the constraint; close es with a number, default stays 4
gates.outcome: NOT RUN -> closed by G-A (capacity is not the constraint because the features/labels are).
